description: Audits Cognigy.AI NLU quality for a flow. Identifies intents with too few training sentences, disabled intents, and optionally checks for overlapping intents. Use this before deployment to ensure NLU quality.

checkOverlap.description: If true, tests for overlapping intents using NLU scoring (slower)

projectId.description: Required if checkOverlap=true - project ID for NLU scoring

name: audit_nlu
